Table 1: The SVRDs and the R&D investment-output ratios when different uncertainty channels are activated. Columns 1 and 3 show outcomes for the less uncertainty aversion case. Columns 2 and 4 show outcomes for the more uncertainty aversion case. Each row shows the outcomes when activating different uncertainty channels: no uncertainty (row 1), climate model only (row 2), damage model only (row 3), capital productivity only (row 4), R&D technology only (row 5), and all channels (row 6). The numbers in the parentheses for the SVRDs are the values in each row as a percentage of the “all channels” outcomes.
